questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city San José?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Costa Rica is San José.

questions.prompt: Which continent is Costa Rica in?

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Costa Rica on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Costa Rica on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.proof: Costa Rica is in North America.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Costa Rica?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Costa Rica on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Costa Rica article.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Costa Rica about 51,180 square kilometres; Haiti about 27,750 square kilometres; Tonga about 749 square kilometres; Federated States of Micronesia about 702 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Costa Rica?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Costa Rica article.

questions.proof: Its capital and largest city is San José.
